claims.claim: Server mode (JSON-RPC 2.0) applies to tools only; evals and hooks are one-shot.
Eval response fields and Value/Details/MetricValue mapping; error makes the result an error.
Assertion fails on error then checks min/max, default min 1.0; guardrail triggers via ScoreThresholds.Triggered (nil score, below min default 1.0, above max).
Hook envelope fields are tagged; payload structs have no json tags so Go field names are used; ProviderRequest includes TurnIndex, Prompt, Replacement; ToolRequest includes Declaration.
A hook with no phases never runs; phase names before_call/after_call/before_execution/after_execution/session_start/session_update/session_end.
mode is optional and defaults to filter; observe waits for the process and discards stdout.
Session hooks in filter mode wait for the process, do not read stdout, and return an error on process failure; ack is never read.
Provider/tool filter hook: missing allow counts false; failure, timeout or invalid JSON denies.
enforced applies to provider hooks only; metadata.replacement supplies the before_call replacement text.
Eval hook receives the JSON EvalResult (snake_case tags) on stdin, stdout discarded, phases and mode ignored.
Server tool process restarts on the next call after exit; in-flight calls fail with exit status and stderr.
stderr is not forwarded to the runtime logger; it is appended to the error message on failure.
Server mode is line-delimited, max 10 MB per line, one process per tool started lazily, concurrent calls matched by id.
A JSON-RPC response with neither result nor error returns null; an invalid line fails pending calls; an unmatched id is dropped.
Exec tool with env set gets only the listed vars; empty env inherits host env; other bindings get host env plus listed vars.
Default timeouts: tool 30s, eval 30s, hooks 10s, eval hooks 5s; timeout_ms overrides.
Eval runner gives an exec eval its binding timeout plus a 5 second grace period.
Tool response: error checked first, then result, else raw stdout is returned.
Eval request fields and omitempty behavior; toolCallView serializes PascalCase keys; Index is the turn index.
